patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). Inside that directory, there will be a folder named 'AssetBundles'. Download the patch archive from the link below Extract all the files from the '18X' folder of the downloaded patch archive into the 'AssetBundles' folder mentioned above, overwriting the existing files when prompted
